title: Suspected Executive Impersonation / Phishing
closure: Not ready: sender identity, user interaction, authentication impact, and message disposition require verification.

evidence.observation: Message used a display name matching a finance executive and requested an urgent payment-related action.
Reply-to identity differs from the expected corporate sender domain.
Recipient reported the message as suspicious before completing the requested action.

hypotheses: Legitimate external communication using a delegated mailbox
Executive impersonation / business email compromise attempt
lessons_learned: Verify sender identity independently before treating impersonation as established.
Preserve headers and message metadata before disposal where policy permits.
